normalization: bias-corrected per-task EMA squared raw norm; 1/sqrt(vhat+eps)
QP: min_d .5||d-gtilde_primary||^2 subject to every secondary dot>=tau||gtilde_secondary||^2; deterministic independent active subsets
magnitude_rescale: raw relchem norm; coefficient primary1 before final rescale
infeasible_policy: canonical primary fallback in aggregator; direct qualification refuses infeasible/non-common direction
precision: matched-F64 chemistry arithmetic/gradient on exact F32-loaded sources and stored main values widened; no native source precision upgrade; existing F32 E/op derivatives widened only after autograd

chemistry_estimator_formulas.R2: one uniform within each8DB, sum n_d/251*ell; existing database factors remain inside ell
chemistry_estimator_formulas.A2: full17 mean each iteration; per-reaction streamed gradients

qualification_rule.R2_selection: Prefer R2 when median/p10 full-gradient cosine and positive-dot fraction improve directionally over R1; otherwise retain R1 if representative. Qualification requires a positive median full-gradient cosine and majority positive dots; each actual sample must independently pass strict PCD geometry. This is a diagnostic screening rule, not a stochastic convergence guarantee.
qualification_rule.AE_selection: Full17 if executable with bounded per-reaction graphs; no invented atom minibatch.
qualification_rule.first_mrks: first entry of immutable sampling protocol, not selected by geometry

acceptance: all4 finite, requested and realized raw gradient dots with delta<0, all4 componentwise Armijo, all4 strict actual decrease

sampling.systems: first5 existing stream: BeH2,H2,BH,CH4,HPSi_iso2; cache15 only
sampling.cursor_rule: advance exactly once after acceptance; stop at first failed sample

checkpoint_monitoring.operator_monitor: same unique15 cached systems, each system once
checkpoint_monitoring.predopt: reused hash-bound full268 metrics and unique15 old predopt panel values; duplicate equality verified; BeH2 exact current frozen equality
checkpoint_monitoring.S5: reused established constants; not reevaluated or used for training

pilot_success_conditions: Jrel and nonAE DBRMSE strictly lower; AE MAE/RMSE no worse; E/op mean no worse and median ratio<=1; all accepted realized common descent and all-task Armijo

future_SCF_spending_gate.AE17: MAE and RMSE<=canonical predopt; report measurable progress beyond reproducibility if available
future_SCF_spending_gate.Exc_operator: each immutable15 mean<=predopt and median ratio<=1
future_SCF_spending_gate.repeatability: two consecutive checkpoints predeclared in a future run
future_SCF_spending_gate.scope: compute-spending permission only, not model/test/publication acceptance; not achieved here

objective_definitions.exc: existing legacy mRKS integrated Exc target and historical one-addition dispersion treatment; kcal/mol RMSE
objective_definitions.op: h-free variational AO XC operator loss: symmetric-orthogonalized squared Hilbert-Schmidt error divided by nAO
objective_definitions.relchem: mean corrected singleton fchem over251 non-AE17 identities; matched-F64 chemistry
objective_definitions.ae17: mean corrected singleton fchem over17 AE17 identities; matched-F64 chemistry

pcd_algorithm.ema_quantity: squared global raw-gradient norm, one scalar per task
pcd_algorithm.qp: minimize 0.5*||d-g_tilde_primary||^2 subject to g_tilde_j dot d >= tau*||g_tilde_j||^2
pcd_algorithm.zero_primary_policy: return exact zero direction after EMA update
pcd_algorithm.infeasible_policy: drop all secondary constraints and use the primary direction
pcd_algorithm.epsilon_scope: inside_sqrt; scale invariance is asymptotic for finite eps

size.justification: Extend existing three-task stack; one bounded-memory chemistry batch callable is needed for F64 shadow scalar and derivatives without retaining8/17 reaction graphs. No second trainer, optimizer, QP dependency or objective implementation.
